description: The chart illustrates macro f-score values for two methods, RECA and GAIT\_GAT, across three frequency classes in the Semtab dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categorical classes labeled “High,” “Medium,” and “Low,” arranged from left to right in that order, with the axis label “Frequency.” The vertical axis is a numeric scale labeled “Macro f-score,” shown on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1 with evenly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.1 intervals. Bars are grouped by frequency class, with two side-by-side bars per group: RECA is shown in a light peach color and GAIT\_GAT is shown in a darker orange color, as indicated by the legend below the plot. Each bar contains a numeric value label: for High frequency, RECA is approximately 0.837 and GAIT\_GAT is approximately 0.877; for Medium frequency, RECA is approximately 0.538 and GAIT\_GAT is approximately 0.609; for Low frequency, RECA is approximately 0.114 and GAIT\_GAT is approximately 0.224. The bars are not displayed as stacked and there are no additional annotations beyond the in-bar value labels and the legend.
